Looking to camp where you can wake at the crack of dawn and start fishing? This is one of several small campgrounds on Tellico River Road (FS Rd 210). This campground offers 7 campsites with a picnic table, fire ring, and lantern post.

Three campground loops offer 92 wooded sites, most of which provide views of Lake Chatuge. Several sites in Loops A and B can accommodate RVs, but no hook-ups are available.   Registered campers may access the on-site RV dump station.

There are trees for 1 hammock. The site has river access. There’s a small clearing that is off trail where 2 more hammocks could be hung, but you’re trampling plants at that point. Horses are not allowed.
